title: #418 Necessary Education
prompt: What is your opinion on the necessity of college education for success in life?

promptSegments.text: What is your opinion on the necessity of college education for success in life?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: College education helps people find better jobs.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Getting a college degree helps people feel more certain about their future.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Getting a college degree helps people feel more certain about their future.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: College education is not the only path to success, focusing on the value of practical skills and on-the-job training.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay emphasizes that specific, practical training and work experience are often more valuable for finding a job than academic degrees.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first main point is that college education gives specialized knowledge, which is essential for securing specific jobs and earning better money.

angles.label: Point 2

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Practical skills and real-world experience are more valuable than academic degrees for success.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Practical skills and real-world experience are more valuable than academic degrees for success.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Personal networking and connections are crucial for finding job opportunities, which is often overlooked by focusing only on education.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Personal networking and connections are crucial for finding job opportunities, which is often overlooked by focusing only on education.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
